Solution Plays.Title: Land with data, expand with AI
Solution Plays.Products: Northwind Data Platform; Northwind AI Studio
Solution Plays.Pitch: One governed home for your data today, AI agents on top of it tomorrow.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: Warehouse renewals and AI pilots are colliding in 2027 budgets.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
How many copies of your customer table exist?
How long does a new data source take to onboard?
Which AI pilot is blocked on data access
Solution Plays.Objections:
Migration is risky -> run side by side, one domain at a time.
We already paid for licenses -> keep them for the long tail.

Solution Plays.Title: Give clinicians time back
Solution Plays.Pitch: AI agents that draft documentation from the chart, with citations, so clinicians finish on time.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: Burnout and staffing shortages top every hospital board agenda.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
How many hours a week do clinicians spend on notes after hours?
Which document takes longest today?
Who owns clinical AI governance
Solution Plays.Objections:
Accuracy -> every line cites its source in the chart.
Privacy -> runs on your governed data, in your tenant.

Solution Plays.Title: Retire the VPN
Solution Plays.Pitch: Per-app zero-trust access that's safer for the bank and easier for users.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: Regulators now expect zero-trust evidence; VPN renewals are due.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
How many apps sit behind your VPN?
What did your last phishing test show?
What do auditors ask you to prove
Solution Plays.Objections:
Users will hate it -> fewer prompts, not more.
We just renewed -> start with contractors and high-risk apps.

Solution Plays.Title: First-time fix, every time
Solution Plays.Pitch: Predict failures, send the right technician with the right part, fix it on the first visit.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: Service margins are under pressure and senior technicians are retiring.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
What is your first-time fix rate today?
How are work orders scheduled?
What does a repeat visit cost
Solution Plays.Objections: Our techs won't use an app -> guided repair saves them time on site.

Solution Plays.Title: Answers for every store
Solution Plays.Pitch: Store managers ask questions in plain language and act the same day.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: Holiday season planning exposes slow, ticket-based reporting.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
How long does a store manager wait for a report?
How many report requests does BI get each week
Solution Plays.Objections: Data quality -> answers come only from certified data.

Solution Plays.Title: Agents your auditors will love
Solution Plays.Products: Northwind AI Studio; Northwind Data Platform
Solution Plays.Pitch: Build AI agents with lineage, evaluation and approvals built in.
Solution Plays.WhyNow: AI regulations require explainability and human oversight in 2027.
Solution Plays.DiscoveryQuestions:
Which AI use cases are stuck in risk review?
How do you evaluate an agent before it goes live
Solution Plays.Objections: We'll build it ourselves -> evaluation and governance are the hard 80%.
